integrity: The two attached checkers reproduce exact polynomial ideal certificates and an independent finite-field census; no external independent audit or formal certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Results concern the smooth two-parameter reciprocal-quartic Howe family over an algebraic closure of characteristic five; counts distinguish ordered parameter pairs, not isomorphism classes. The proof does not classify Newton polygons, all genus-five Howe curves, or positive characteristics other than five. Potential uncatalogued special-family overlap remains.
title: Exact characteristic-five rank strata in a genus-five Howe family
